Author: Vivek Varma

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:48854

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 10992 of 2024

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rahul Singh Dahiya
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.

The present Anticipatory Bail Application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail
to the applicant in Case Crime No. 196 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 313, 504, 506, 342 I.P.C.
and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Kakod, District- Bulandshahr, during the
pendency of trial.

entities.text: Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Kakod, District- Bulandshahr
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. After arguing the matter at some length, Sri Rahul Singh Dahiya, counsel for the applicant prays
for withdrawal of the present application with liberty to the applicant to surrender and apply for
regular bail.
3.  In view of the above, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
